questions.question: Whose words did Kardama recall as he replied to Devahuti's words full of renunciation?
questions.explanation: "Recalling the words of Lord Viṣṇu, the merciful sage Kardama replied as follows." (SB 3.24.1)

questions.question: What did Kardama tell Devahuti the infallible Supreme Personality of Godhead would shortly do?

options.text: Enter her womb as her son

questions.explanation: "The infallible Supreme Personality of Godhead will shortly enter your womb as your son." (SB 3.24.2)

questions.question: According to Kardama, the Lord will vanquish the knot of Devahuti's heart by becoming her son and teaching knowledge of what?
questions.explanation: "He will vanquish the knot of your heart by becoming your son and teaching knowledge of Brahman." (SB 3.24.4)

questions.question: How did the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Madhusudana, appear in Devahuti, having entered the semen of Kardama?

options.text: Just as light comes from the sun
Just as fire comes from wood in a sacrifice
Just as a river flows to the sea

questions.explanation: "Appeared in Devahūti just as fire comes from wood in a sacrifice." (SB 3.24.6)

questions.question: Who came along with Marichi and other sages to Kardama's hermitage at the Lord's appearance?
questions.explanation: "The first-born living being, went along with Marīci and other sages to the place of Kardama's hermitage." (SB 3.24.9)

questions.question: Brahma understood the Lord had appeared in Devahuti's womb to explain which system of knowledge?
questions.explanation: "Had appeared in the womb of Devahūti just to explain the complete state of knowledge known as sāṅkhya-yoga." (SB 3.24.10)

questions.question: Brahma said sons ought to obey the command of a father or spiritual master with due deference, saying what?
questions.explanation: "One should obey the command of his father or spiritual master with due deference, saying, 'Yes, sir.'" (SB 3.24.13)

questions.question: Brahma instructed Kardama to give away his nine daughters to whom?
questions.explanation: "Today please give away your daughters to the foremost of the sages." (SB 3.24.15)

questions.question: Brahma told Kardama the Supreme Personality of Godhead had assumed the body of which Muni?
questions.explanation: "He has now assumed the body of Kapila Muni." (SB 3.24.16)

questions.question: By what physical feature is Kapila Muni characterized, as described by Brahma?
questions.explanation: "Kapila Muni, who is characterized by His golden hair, His eyes just like lotus petals." (SB 3.24.17)

questions.question: Which demon does Brahma say the Supreme Lord, now within Devahuti's womb, had killed?
questions.explanation: "The same Supreme Personality of Godhead who killed the demon Kaiṭabha is now within your womb." (SB 3.24.18)

questions.question: By what name will Devahuti's son be celebrated among the people, as the head of all perfected souls?
questions.explanation: "Among the people He will be celebrated by the name Kapila." (SB 3.24.19)

questions.question: On what carrier did Lord Brahma, also known as Hamsa, return to the highest planetary system?
questions.explanation: "Lord Brahmā... went back to the highest of the three planetary systems on his swan carrier with the four Kumāras and Nārada." (SB 3.24.20)

questions.question: After Brahma's departure, to whom did Kardama hand over his nine daughters?

options.text: The nine great sages who created the population of the world

questions.explanation: "Kardama Muni... handed over his nine daughters, as instructed, to the nine great sages who created the population of the world." (SB 3.24.21)

questions.question: To which sage did Kardama deliver his daughter Santi, because of whom sacrificial ceremonies are well performed?
questions.explanation: "He delivered Śānti to Atharvā. Because of Śānti, sacrificial ceremonies are well performed." (SB 3.24.24)

questions.question: What order of life did Kardama wish to accept, having been liberated by the Lord from his debts to his father?

options.text: The order of an itinerant mendicant

questions.explanation: "I wish to accept the order of an itinerant mendicant." (SB 3.24.34)

questions.question: The Personality of Godhead Kapila said His appearance was especially to explain which philosophy?
questions.explanation: "My appearance in this world is especially to explain the philosophy of Sāṅkhya." (SB 3.24.36)

questions.question: Kapila said this path of self-realization had now been lost in the course of what?
questions.explanation: "This path of self-realization, which is difficult to understand, has now been lost in the course of time." (SB 3.24.37)

questions.question: To whom did Kapila say He would also describe this sublime knowledge so she could attain perfection?
questions.explanation: "I shall also describe this sublime knowledge, which is the door to spiritual life, to My mother." (SB 3.24.40)

questions.question: After being spoken to by his son Kapila, what vow did Kardama accept as he left for the forest?
questions.explanation: "The sage Kardama accepted silence as a vow in order to think of the Supreme Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.24.42)

questions.question: Freed from all hatred and desire, what did Kardama Muni ultimately attain?
questions.explanation: "Kardama Muni... ultimately attained the path back to Godhead." (SB 3.24.47)
